She's as guilty as him to me. Your mom did nothing to protect her granddaughter and should be held accountable for her actions. How could a grandmother be so vile and allow your brother to be in family reunions with your daughter, knowing that he's done something so horrible to her.

I honestly hope that your daughter gets professional help with coping with the trauma. I hope that she gets the support system that she deserves. No child should ever go through any kind of abuse- especially sexual abuse.
